entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection establishment
entities.description: Establishment of an N1 NAS signalling connection over non-3GPP access initiated by the UE.

entities.name: Access identities
entities.description: Identities used by the UE to determine priority and access type for NAS signalling connection establishment.

entities.name: Establishment cause for non-3GPP access
entities.description: The cause value selected by the UE for initiating N1 NAS signalling connection over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Rule selection for establishment cause
entities.description: Condition where if multiple rules match, the establishment cause with the lowest rule number is selected.

entities.name: Emergency session access attempt
entities.description: UE is attempting access for an emergency session, including specific 5GMM procedures and PDU session establishment for emergency.

entities.name: MO signalling access attempt
entities.description: Access attempt is for Mobile Originated signalling, triggered by UE NAS initiated 5GMM specific procedures.

entities.name: MO data access attempt
entities.description: Access attempt is for Mobile Originated data, triggered by UE NAS initiated 5GMM connection management procedures or 5GMM NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: MO SMS over NAS or IP access attempt
entities.description: Access attempt is for Mobile Originated SMS over NAS or SMS over IP.

entities.name: MO MMTel voice call access attempt
entities.description: Access attempt is for Mobile Originated MMTel voice call.

entities.name: MO MMTel video call access attempt
entities.description: Access attempt is for Mobile Originated MMTel video call.

relations.description: UE determines access identities as part of N1 NAS signalling connection establishment.
UE selects and provides the establishment cause for non-3GPP access to lower layers.
Establishment cause selection is guarded by the rule that the lowest rule number is used if multiple rules match.
Emergency session access attempt establishes the 'emergency' establishment cause.
MO signalling access attempt establishes the 'mo-Signalling' establishment cause.
MO data access attempt establishes the 'mo-Data' establishment cause.
MO SMS access attempt establishes the 'mo-SMS' establishment cause.
MO MMTel voice call access attempt establishes the 'mo-VoiceCall' establishment cause.
MO MMTel video call access attempt establishes the 'mo-Videocall' establishment cause.
